value.text:
Identifying which memo handlers broadcast through the event hub.

Direct handlers are CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction. UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations broadcast indirectly through dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects.

The SSE hub is located at server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go. The direct broadcast handlers appear to be CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, and CreateMemoComment. Reaction, attachment, and relation handlers may also broadcast through it. I will verify this against AGENTS.md and tests.

Eight memo handlers broadcast through the SSE hub: CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, CreateMemoComment, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction. Six of these use direct broadcast. The remaining two route through dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects.
